snippet.title: Megaman W Teaser
snippet.description:
Mega Man W is an upcoming fan game by Team W. 

Music shown in the trailer by Duccly
you can follow him here: https://soundcloud.com/duccly

Follow us on Itch: https://jumpdashevade.itch.io/mega-man-w
Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/JumpDashEvade

Big shoutouts to Objectionable who created the Trailer
Her YT can be found here :  https://www.youtube.com/@objectionable6693

And come check out the Game discord https://discord.gg/XwzNJSR5UM
